note: The Power Automate flows of builds B6 and B7 (D295, D301), as Carlos makes them by hand in the company tenant with the steps of powerbi/README.md §6. One entry per flow: its name (the Power Apps call a flow by it), the trigger, the inputs a Power App gives it, the concurrency of the trigger (1: one run at a time; the others wait) and the steps in order. A flow refreshes, waits, files a report or a reply, or sends exactly the message a manager pressed Send or Test on: its To, Cc, Subject and Body are the inputs of the trigger, never made by the flow (D2, D301). None runs on a timer (D269). npm run powerbi:lint checks these rules and that the apps call only flows of this file. The workspace and the semantic model are picked from a list in the step: the workspace is the one Carlos made (README section 4), the semantic model has the name of the .pbip.

flows.name: SACMRefresh
flows.purpose: Refresh the report after a manager saved an action in the Power App, or pressed Refresh now in it.

flows.name: SACMSend
flows.purpose: Send the message a manager pressed Send on in the Power App SACM messages, from the shared mailbox, exactly as the app gives it. The app records it in the journal after the flow answers.

steps.action: Send an email from a shared mailbox (V2)

flows.name: SACMTest
flows.purpose: Send a test of a message to the manager who pressed Test, from the shared mailbox. Nobody else gets it, and the cases are not changed.

steps.action: Send an email from a shared mailbox (V2)

flows.name: SACM refresh now
flows.purpose: The button Refresh now on the pages My day and Reports (the Power Automate visual).

flows.name: SACM - File reports
flows.purpose: File each report the shared mailbox gets in the reports folder of the team site, then refresh the report.
flows.trigger: When a new email arrives in a shared mailbox (V2)

fields.File Name: the date of today, an underscore and the name of the attachment

flows.name: SACM - File replies
flows.purpose: File each reply to a SACM message that comes to the shared mailbox (its subject holds [SACM-…]) in the list SACM Replies, then refresh the report.
flows.trigger: When a new email arrives in a shared mailbox (V2)

fields.Title: the reference in the subject: the text from [SACM- to the next ]
fields.Received: the Received Time of the email
fields.Subject: the Subject of the email
fields.Body: the text of the step Html to text
fields.ConversationId: the Conversation Id of the email
